leorio_paradinight.title: Medical Student & Zodiac ("Boar")
leorio_paradinight.bio: Aspiring physician working tirelessly to pay medical school tuition fees. Always seeking funds.

gon_freecss.title: Rookie Hunter / Enhancer
gon_freecss.bio: Traveled from Whale Island in search of his father Ging. Spent all his savings on fishing gear.

killua_zoldyck.title: Ex-Assassin Heir / Transmuter
killua_zoldyck.bio: Blew his entire savings at the Heavens Arena confectionery shop buying ChocoRobo-kun snacks.

kurapika_kurta.title: Blacklist Hunter & Nostrade Boss
kurapika_kurta.bio: Last survivor of the Kurta Clan. Allocated all Nostrade family treasury assets into auction intelligence.

hisoka_morow.title: Grim Reaper Magician
hisoka_morow.bio: Has zero interest in physical currency. Only seeks unripe fruit to duel to the death.

tonpa_crusher.title: Rookie Crusher Veteran
tonpa_crusher.bio: Participated in 35 consecutive Hunter exams. Bankrupted himself purchasing industrial laxatives.

hanzo_ninja.title: Cloud Hidden Shinobi
hanzo_ninja.bio: Elite ninja pursuing the Secret Scroll of the Hermit. Carries only survival shurikens and rations.

pokkle_archer.title: Beast Hunter / Archer
pokkle_archer.bio: Specializes in undiscovered creature classification. Expended all capital on NGL exploration equipment.

ponzu_bees.title: Chemical & Bee Specialist
ponzu_bees.bio: Carries neurotoxin bees inside her hat. Zero Jenny remaining after apiary laboratory upgrades.

illumi_zoldyck.title: Assassin Operative / Needle Master
illumi_zoldyck.bio: Transfers all contract assassination fees directly into the Kukuroo Mountain Family trust account.

chrollo_lucilfer.title: Phantom Troupe Head (Spider #0)
chrollo_lucilfer.bio: We steal everything we want. Money holds no value to the Spider, only rare artifacts and stolen Nen abilities.

feitan_portor.title: Phantom Troupe Interrogator (#2)
feitan_portor.bio: Master of torture and interrogation. Possesses no bank accounts in the civilized world.

machi_komacine.title: Nen Stitch Specialist (#3)
machi_komacine.bio: Charges exorbitant rates for re-attaching severed limbs (e.g. Hisoka), but kept all funds in Meteor City caches.

zepile_appraiser.title: Yorknew Antique & Treasure Appraiser
zepile_appraiser.bio: Fell into severe debt pawning his Hunter License to finance bidding wars at the Southernpiece Auction.

milluki_zoldyck.title: Zoldyck Estate Hacker & Otaku Collector
milluki_zoldyck.bio: Second son of the Zoldyck family. Hoards an emergency reserve of 10,000 Ⓙ in his Yorknew online account to purchase ultra-rare anime figurines and Greed Island memory cards.
